title: A proof of the Auluck-Chowla-Gupta Conjecture: paper and verification code
description: Paper and complete reproducible verification code for a proof that, for every n ≥ 1, the sequence p(n,1), ..., p(n,n) of partitions of n into exactly k parts is unimodal (the Auluck–Chowla–Gupta conjecture, 1942; Szekeres 1953 proved it for sufficiently large n without an explicit threshold). The analytic part (n ≥ 10^5) is certified in Arb ball arithmetic; the finite part (n ≤ 2·10^5) is verified by two independent programs, one using exact integer arithmetic only. Run ./run_all.sh to reproduce.
